data.one_liner: A collection of Flutter Column and Row widgets with additional functionality.
data.what_it_does: Provides specialized variations of Columns and Rows like PaddedColumn, SeparatedColumn, and ExpandedScrollingColumn to simplify common layout patterns and reduce boilerplate code.
use_when: You need to add consistent padding or separators to Columns and Rows without nested boilerplate
You want expandable children inside a scrolling Column or Row without layout errors
avoid_when: You only need standard Flutter Columns and Rows
strengths: Saves boilerplate when adding padding and separators to flex widgets
Solves common scrolling and expanding layout conflicts
weaknesses: Limited to basic enhancements for Columns and Rows
